parameter_mappings.notes: Database name converted to lowercase following PostgreSQL conventions

SSL handling different in PostgreSQL, parameter removed

host.description: PostgreSQL server hostname or IP address
host.production_recommendation: Update to actual PostgreSQL server hostname

port.note: Can be customized if PostgreSQL runs on different port

database.note: Must match the actual database name in PostgreSQL server

username.security_note: Default 'postgres' user used, should be changed to application-specific user in production

password.security_warning: CRITICAL: Default password used, MUST be changed for production deployments

pooling.description: Enable connection pooling for better performance

minpoolsize.description: Minimum number of connections in the pool

maxpoolsize.description: Maximum number of connections in the pool
maxpoolsize.tuning_note: Can be adjusted based on application load and database capacity

recommendations: Use environment variables for sensitive configuration
Use dotnet user-secrets for development: dotnet user-secrets set ConnectionStrings:DevConnection "<connection-string>"
Use Azure Key Vault for Azure deployments
Use AWS Secrets Manager for AWS deployments
Use HashiCorp Vault for multi-cloud deployments
Implement connection string encryption for on-premises deployments
Create application-specific PostgreSQL user with limited privileges
Use principle of least privilege - grant only necessary permissions
Consider using certificate-based authentication for production
Enable SSL/TLS for database connections in production
Add SslMode parameter: SslMode=Require or SslMode=VerifyFull
Configure PostgreSQL server to require SSL connections
Use VPN or private network for database access when possible

development.connection_string: Current configuration acceptable for local development
development.user_secrets: Consider using dotnet user-secrets to keep passwords out of source control
development.database: Ensure PostgreSQL server is installed locally or use Docker container

staging.connection_string: Update Host to staging database server
staging.authentication: Use staging-specific credentials from secure vault
staging.connection_pooling: Tune pool size based on staging load

production.connection_string: Update Host to production database server or cluster
production.authentication: Use production-specific credentials from secure vault (Key Vault, Secrets Manager)
production.ssl: MUST enable SSL/TLS with certificate verification (SslMode=VerifyFull)
production.connection_pooling: Tune pool size based on production load and monitoring
production.high_availability: Consider using connection string with multiple hosts for failover

database_setup_requirements.postgresql_server: PostgreSQL server must be installed and running
database_setup_requirements.schema_migration: Tables must be created: productmanagement_dbo.products, productmanagement_dbo.producthistory, productmanagement_dbo.productstats
user_permissions: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE privileges on all tables

build_verification.note: Project compiles successfully with PostgreSQL connection strings

testing_recommendations: Set up local PostgreSQL instance for development testing
Run migration scripts to create database schema
Test connection: Use PostgreSQL client to verify connection with provided credentials
Test application: Run application and verify it can connect to PostgreSQL
Test all CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
Test error scenarios (connection failures, constraint violations)
Load test to verify pool size configuration
